objective: I can practice checking the result. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner and the supervising guardian return to the room where the job happened the day before, bringing the original step list.
safetyNotes: If finishing an incomplete checklist item involves heat, a sharp tool, or a chemical cleaner, the supervising guardian handles that exact step or stays directly present for it before it counts as finished.
The guardian decides whether re-entering the job space to finish an item needs the same supervision level named in the original plan.

simulationAlternative.description: If the live check cannot happen right after the job because the guardian was not available at the same time, the learner instead completes a written or drawn walkthrough of the finished-loop checklist from memory, and the guardian confirms afterward, as discussed together, whether each item matches what actually happened.

materials: learner-local: the original step list and materials list
learner-local: the space where the job happened

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one checklist item that was easy to check and one that was harder to check, and explain what made the harder one more difficult to judge.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Checklist thoroughness: All four checklist items are checked together with the guardian. | Completion accuracy: Any unfinished piece is identified and completed before the job counts as done. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner design one new checklist item that would catch a problem their current four-item checklist might miss, based on something noticed during today's check, and add it to future job checks.

resources.title: checking the result worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner and the supervising guardian return to the room where the job happened the day before, bringing the original step list.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact checking the result decision or action.
Model move 2: Before checking anything, look at the space with fresh eyes, as if seeing it for the first time today.
Model move 3: With your guardian, go through the finished-loop checklist one item at a time and mark each one together.

Model check: Checklist thoroughness: All four checklist items are checked together with the guardian. | Completion accuracy: Any unfinished piece is identified and completed before the job counts as done.

resources.title: checking the result action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for checking the result.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: checking the result coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner and the supervising guardian return to the room where the job happened the day before, bringing the original step list.
Coach direction: Before checking anything, look at the space with fresh eyes, as if seeing it for the first time today.
Learner prompt: Name one thing about the space right now that looks the way you pictured it back on day one.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: checking the result complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: With your guardian, go through the finished-loop checklist one item at a time and mark each one together.
Response 1 (t2-p1): Every step on the original plan was actually completed, not just started.
Response 2 (t2-p2): Every material used is back in its original spot, not left out.
Response 3 (t2-p3): The space matches what was pictured on day one, or the difference is explained.
Response 4 (t2-p4): Nothing about the job was left half-finished.

Equal-access rule: If the live check cannot happen right after the job because the guardian was not available at the same time, the learner instead completes a written or drawn walkthrough of the finished-loop checklist from memory, and the guardian confirms afterward, as discussed together, whether each item matches what actually happened.

resources.title: checking the result minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one checklist item that was easy to check and one that was harder to check, and explain what made the harder one more difficult to judge.

Success checks: Checklist thoroughness: All four checklist items are checked together with the guardian. | Completion accuracy: Any unfinished piece is identified and completed before the job counts as done.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: checking the result supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional checking the result condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Checklist thoroughness: All four checklist items are checked together with the guardian. | Completion accuracy: Any unfinished piece is identified and completed before the job counts as done..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: The learner and the supervising guardian return to the room where the job happened the day before, bringing the original step list.
guidedFirstAttempt.prompt: Name one thing about the space right now that looks the way you pictured it back on day one.

guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Checklist thoroughness: All four checklist items are checked together with the guardian.

realRoute.title: checking the result — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Do not begin the physical action until a household-authorized guardian gives permission and is available for the supervision or review named in this lesson.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
With your guardian, go through the finished-loop checklist one item at a time and mark each one together.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record; only the household-authorized guardian attests that the named physical action occurred.

simulationRoute.title: checking the result — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: If the live check cannot happen right after the job because the guardian was not available at the same time, the learner instead completes a written or drawn walkthrough of the finished-loop checklist from memory, and the guardian confirms afterward, as discussed together, whether each item matches what actually happened.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Checklist thoroughness: All four checklist items are checked together with the guardian. | Completion accuracy: Any unfinished piece is identified and completed before the job counts as done.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u06-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
